messages:
Maya: Need a 1-page gated brief for webinar followers: compare Hosted / Dedicated / Private with a security-first lens, one benchmark stat, inbound routing rules for leads, and 4 field-ready bullets. Draft by EOD Tue.

Oliver: Ill handle the deploy comparison table + a one-line SLA statement.

Hana: Ill add the benchmark narrative and a short footnote describing test conditions.

Priya: Field bullets coming: exec, platform, security, procurement. Also add the webinar CTA copy.

Samir: Bench nugget (summarized):
Hosted p99 = 118ms (~$8.2 / 1M tokens)
Dedicated p99 = 85ms (~$5.3 / 1M tokens, reserved infra)
Private p99 = 92ms (~$6.1 / 1M tokens, infra-dependent)
Footnote: model-mid, seq=2500, 6k samples, mixed prompts.

Priya: Bullets (short):
- Exec: "Match deployment to compliance & uptime needs  turnkey hosted or locked-down private."
- Platform: "One API, same SDKs, consistent SLAs across modes."
- Security: "KMS/HSM, encryption at rest, per-route audit logs, VPC options."
- Procurement: "Hosted = PAYG, Dedicated = reserved monthly, Private = license + support."

Oliver: Inbound routing proposal for webinar leads:
- Attended + demo interest -> SDR from enterprise queue (tag: secure-deploy)
- Download asset only -> automated nurture (3-email cadence)
- High-risk industry (healthcare/finserv) -> send to solutions SE for fast follow-up
Include these as footnotes so sellers know routing.

Design: Keep visual simple: 3-column table, tiny p99 bars, single bullet list. Will mock by Wed AM.

ops-bot: Reminder: add SOC2/ISO links when ready  https://redwood.example.com/compliance (placeholder).

Hana: Proposed benchmark narrative (one sentence): "In our mixed-workload test (model-mid, seq=2500), Dedicated showed ~25-28% lower p99 latency vs Hosted, with lower unit cost under reserved pricing."

Priya: CTA: "Watch the replay + get the secure-deploy brief [download link]  Book a 15-min infra walkthrough."

Maya: Timeline: Oliver/Hana post draft by Mon noon, Priya polishes language by Mon 4pm, Design handoff Tue AM, routing rules to ops by Tue EOD.

Samir: Uploading the bench CSV to shared drive and linking in the doc.

Oliver: I'll also add a one-line fallback-resilience note: "Automatic routing and compatible-model fallbacks maintain app availability during capacity or regional events."

Maya: Perfect. If no blockers Ill mark this the canonical webinar brief and wire it as the gated asset. Thanks team :rocket:
